create.name: Lisa Barnett
create.bio:
Lisa Barnett is an Akashic Records teacher and ordained minister who founded the Akashic Knowing School of Wisdom. She left a demanding corporate career during a long period of personal crisis, and says that from the mid-1990s she felt called by the keepers of the Akashic Records to bring their guidance to others. In 2005 she began working with the records in depth, and over time developed a set of sacred prayers she teaches as a five-step method for opening one's own record.

Her teaching centres on helping students read their own soul record to understand life purpose, soul agreements, past lives and the patterns that repeat in relationships and work. She offers private readings, self-paced home-study courses, live online programmes, a year-long certification for people who want to read for others, and an annual in-person conference in California. Her books include Your Soul Has a Plan and a Weiser title, The Infinite Wisdom of the Akashic Records. She also compiled Akasha, a collection of first-person accounts. Her YouTube channel gathers talks and interviews on the records and soul purpose.

books.title: The Infinite Wisdom of the Akashic Records
books.author: Lisa Barnett
books.description: Her Weiser book setting out a five-step prayer method for opening your own Akashic Record. It covers what the records are and how readers can use them for guidance in daily life.

books.title: Your Soul Has a Plan: Awaken to Your Life Purpose Through Your Akashic Records
books.author: Lisa Barnett
books.description: A guide to finding life purpose through the Akashic Records, looking at the plan a soul sets before birth and how to read it.

books.title: Akasha: Spiritual Experiences of Accessing the Infinite Intelligence of Our Souls
books.author: Lisa Barnett
books.description: A collection of first-person accounts of working with the Akashic Records, with her introduction to the record keepers, soul contracts and simple practices.

courses.title: Akashic Records Reading & Healing Sessions with Lisa Barnett
courses.description: Private 55-minute sessions in which she reads your Akashic Record for guidance on purpose, path, relationships and work. Packages of three or six sessions are also offered.
courses.price: $555 USD per session; 3 sessions $1,332 USD; 6 sessions $2,664 USD

courses.title: Course 1: Learn To Read Your Akashic Records (Home Study)
courses.description: A self-paced beginners' course teaching her five-step prayer method for opening your own record and receiving guidance from it.

courses.title: Course 2: Access Ancient Soul Wisdom & Past Lives (Home Study)
courses.description: A self-paced follow-on course exploring further areas of your record, including past lives, ancestral lines and creativity.

courses.title: Akashic Knowing Annual Conference
courses.description: Her school's fourth in-person gathering on the Akashic Records in San Bruno, California, planned for April 2027, with talks and practice sessions. An add-on lets newcomers take Course 1 alongside it.
courses.price: $350 USD if booked by 31 Dec 2026; $450 USD Jan-Feb 2027; $525 USD from 1 Mar 2027

courses.title: Akashic Records Meditations
courses.description: Downloadable guided meditations from her school for connecting with the records through the heart. They complement the prayers in her books.

free_resources.title: “Awaken To Rise”: FREE Masterclass Series
free_resources.description: A free recorded masterclass on her YouTube channel introducing the Akashic Records and how working with them can guide your choices.
